_comment: MT5-style account and contract specs used by the backtester. Defaults are typical values; replace them with your broker's numbers (MT5: Market Watch > right click symbol > Specification) so results match your account. Spreads come from the real tick data; extra_spread_points widens them if your broker is wider than the data feed.

server_time._comment: MT5 server clock = base_tz wall time + offset_hours. New York + 7h puts 00:00 at the New York close (GMT+2 winter / GMT+3 summer), the most common broker setting.
